decisions.rationale: Short-coupled polymorphic ventricular tachycardia/ventricular fibrillation is a variant of idiopathic ventricular fibrillation, but the provided snippets do not fully resolve the relation.
Early Repolarization Syndrome is not directly related to the ventricular tachycardia and fibrillation described in the vignette, and the provided snippets support this unrelated relation.
